summary: Iteration 3 focused frontend testing on the 'Jai' hero-title clipping bug fix and the Home→About refactor. All primary items PASS. Hero mask-line now has line-height:1.02 with padding-top:0.08em — measurements confirm inner motion.span top (103.98px) is 13.11px BELOW outer container top (90.88px), so the 'J' glyph is fully visible (no top clipping). Home page is compact: no about-chapters/ashtakam on /; home-directory renders all 12 expected cards with correct data-testids. New /about page loads with about-chapters section, hero copy 'A vow, a lineage...', Ashtakam quote block, and 'Write to the Trust' CTA link (rendered uppercase via CSS). Nav includes nav-about and all 12 previous nav items (some hidden below xl breakpoint at 1440px viewport due to space — visible at ≥1280 as designed). All secondary routes /temple, /ratha-yatra, /gita-govinda, /jagannathastakam, /gaudiya, /vedanta, /acharyas, /nityanushtanam, /gallery, /marketplace, /payment, /contact return 200. Backend regression skipped per request scope (frontend only, and iterations 1&2 already 100%).
critical_code_review_comments: Console shows repeated 401 errors from an auth check request (likely GET /api/auth/me from a client-side session probe) firing on every route change. Not a functional bug (expected when unauthenticated), but consider suppressing/silencing these to keep the browser console clean for end users.

Some nav links (Ratha Yatra, Gita Govinda, Ashtakam, Nityanushtanam) are truncated at 1440px viewport width even though xl breakpoint is ≥1280px. Consider tightening nav spacing or reducing item count in the primary nav — current layout barely fits at 1440px.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 verified 'Jai' clipping fix (measured: innerTop 103.98 vs outerTop 90.88; outerHeight-innerHeight = 13.11px padding all inside — no clipping) and the Home→About refactor. All 12 home-directory cards, nav-about, /about page (chapters + ashtakam + CTA) confirmed. No follow-up needed for this iteration's scope.
